organization_note: ByteDance's own pages describe more than 150,000 employees in nearly 120 cities and list offices by region, but name no headquarters; its website is provided by ByteDance Ltd. of the Cayman Islands. The ByteDance Seed team develops the models, Beijing Volcano Engine Technology operates Volcano Engine Ark in China, and BytePlus Pte. Ltd. of Singapore operates BytePlus ModelArk. The catalog names the developer and both operators, so all three names belong to this record.
